newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ's Brash at NZ parliament -- declines comment.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ's Brash at NZ parliament -- declines comment.

text.p: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Governor Don Brash was at parliament late on Tuesday evening after the announcement of a National-New Zealand First Coalition government.
Brash declined comment on why he was there or who he was meeting.

The new government announced it was widening the RB's annual inflation target to 0-3 percent from 0-2 percent and has added sustainable growth as an additional target, the latter being something Brash is on record as opposing.
